identity_check: Confirmed as Vinci (Vinci4D Inc., getvinci.ai), the Palo Alto start-up building a physics foundation model for hardware-engineering simulation. Eclipse's post 'The ChatGPT for Physics' (2025-12-05) links https://www.getvinci.ai/ and names the same founder (Hardik Kabaria) and round ($46M seed and Series A from Eclipse, Xora Innovation and Khosla Ventures); getvinci.ai's own release, team page and newsroom match, and SiliconANGLE names the legal entity Vinci4D Inc. (the site's forms also say 'Vinci4d'). Not any other company called Vinci (the name is widely used, including by a large construction group); identity rests on the getvinci.ai domain Eclipse links. Category set to 'adjacent' (not in the PROJECT_CONTEXT §7 seed list; found through Eclipse's portfolio): Vinci sells design-stage software to hardware engineering teams, the same buyer as Utopian Autonomy's requirements / design-intent tooling, and its stated roadmap is to move from simulation toward telling engineers what to change and 'eventually toward creating designs from human intent'. It is not direct because today it is a CAE / simulation product (thermal, thermo-mechanical, convective flow) sold mainly to semiconductor and electronics-packaging teams, not requirements or design-intent capture, and it does nothing on the plant floor (procurement, maintenance, process stability, RFQ / BOM). Layer design_intent is the nearest fit; there is no simulation layer in the taxonomy.

company.name: Vinci
company.description: Palo Alto start-up whose pre-trained physics foundation model runs fast, solver-accurate thermal and thermo-mechanical simulation of full-resolution hardware designs, starting with semiconductors.

layer_detail: Design-stage physics simulation (CAE) rather than requirements or design-intent capture: thermal, thermo-mechanical (warpage, stress) and convective-fluid analysis on native layout and design files (OASIS / GDS / IPC-2581) for chips, advanced packages, PCBs and enclosures, behind the customer's firewall. Users are hardware / packaging engineers at semiconductor and electronics companies. Roadmap: CFD, electromagnetics, mechanics and manufacturability, agentic engineering workflows, then recommending design changes and generating designs from intent; also aiming at vehicles, aircraft and satellites.
product_summary: Pre-trained physics foundation model that ingests native design and layout files, meshes automatically and returns deterministic, solver-grade thermal, thermo-mechanical (warpage, stress) and convective-flow simulations at manufacturing resolution in minutes, behind the customer's firewall and without training on customer data. First market: semiconductors and electronics packaging.
